description: City Wide Water and Sewer Main Replacement is a dataset listed in City of Kansas City open data portal (data.kcmo.org), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Kansas City. This data set contains the miles of completed water main replacement that has occurred in past (and current) fiscal years. These operations are carried out by the Water Services Department. Coverage: Kansas City, Missouri. The portal files it under the category Sustainability. Its tags are water main replacement, miles completed, watermain, miles replaced, water main. The table has 6 columns. Attribution on the portal: Water Services Department for KCSTAT. The portal shows 2016-08-30 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-kcmo-org-portal.
